description: Who is in the same trade: clusters of vaults sharing an instrument or book, per cluster the vaults, gross and net notional, directional skew, the venue’s open interest and our coverage of it (coverageRatio, never shipped without its denominator), with the snapshot’s freshness and the populations of positions read. asOf reads the book as it stood. Observed gross exposure only: books on a centralised exchange are invisible. FREE; cluster members (members=true) are paid.

asOf.description: An ISO date or time: the newest snapshot at or before it.

instrument.description: Restrict to one instrument, e.g. BTC.

members.description: Include which vaults are in each cluster. Needs a plan.

name: crowding_clusters

items.description: Per cluster: label, kind, instrument, vaultCount, grossUsd, netUsd, directionalSkew, openInterestUsd, coverageRatio, coverageSuspect, members (null unless asked and paid) with membersOmitted.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

positionPopulations.description: Per venue: vaults with positions read in 2 days and ever, with capital.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Crowded trades
